spans.s:
√bhī (V. bháyate; V. and later, bibhéti;
bibhā́ya; ábhaiṣīt; bheṣyáti; bhītá;
bhétum; caus. bhīṣáyate [1042f]). fear;
be afraid of (abl.); bhīta, having feared,
frightened; caus. affright. [w. bi-bhé-ti,
cf. Old High Ger. bi-bē-t, ‘trembles,’ whose
bi- is syllable of reduplication, Ger. bebt,
AS. beofað, ‘trembles’: the connection of
these words with φέ-β-ομαι, ‘am afeard,
flee in fright,’ and φόβος, ‘fear,’ is still a
moot-point.]
